Non-career household case reuses same owner without fabricated amounts or advice
Large history bounded by deterministic whole-record budget, no sentence truncation
Expired evidence excluded; external content never executable instructions
Method, professional and provider boundaries remain separate
Cross-origin write denied
Existing production READ_ONLY guard still rejects write before database access
Concurrent mutations cannot overwrite one another: one commits, one conflicts
Existing account-session revocation prevents subsequent case reads
